verdict.rationale: Elastic documents self-managed deployment options, including a one-liner Docker quickstart for Elasticsearch and Kibana, and a community user reports Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes works well for running clusters. However, the evidence does not show that self-hosting matches the hosted product. Serverless autoscaling, independently scaled search and index tiers, and cross-project search are described only as Elastic-managed features, and community users note that proprietary add-ons sit in cloud and subscription tiers. Missing for 10: evidence of feature parity between self-managed and hosted, self-hosted equivalents of the serverless autoscaling and tier separation, and production-grade self-managed deployment docs beyond the local quickstart.
